$comment: Declared two-tier contract between this repo and the Vaeloom skill catalog.
check_catalog_fidelity.py compares reality against this file and FAILS on any
difference. Without it the check could only ever be red, because the two sets
Two tiers exist because skill_injection drops whole skills rather than
truncating them, so a directive that does not fit SKILL_DIRECTIVE_TOKEN_BUDGET
is silently excluded from the run. This repo holds the full reference; the app
holds a condensed directive sized to fit.

catalog_only.$comment: App-native skills with no source in this repo. Engineering/process skills that belong to the platform, not to the career catalog. Declared so an accidental addition is caught.

repo_only.$comment: Career skills in this repo that the app catalog does not serve. Measured: none of these can ever reach an agent, because the catalog is the only thing skill_injection reads. Listed so the gap is explicit rather than invisible.

condensed_only_triggers.$comment: Trigger phrases the condensed directive declares that the full reference does not. Permitted: the condensed tier may be given extra activation phrases. The reverse direction is NOT permitted and is checked as a failure, because a dropped trigger means a real request activates nothing.
